main_measure.name: pooled fwd 5-bar return, top-quintile forecast minus zero forecast
main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 and positive in at least 2 of 3 coins to confirm; excess <= 0 and non-positive in at least 2 coins to reject

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank corr of forecast vs fwd 5-bar return (positive forecasts)

decided_by: Inconclusive: the coins disagree beyond the confirm and reject rules.
reading: The top-quintile cut-off is the 80th percentile of all positive forecasts, pooled across coins and windows (bars at or above it count); samples are the grid bars 0, 5, 10, ... of each window; the Spearman check uses the same grid; and since only 2 coins are in the record, the 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' counts are applied literally to the coins present.
